title: Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of TaNbVTiAlx Refractory High-Entropy Alloys
process_description: prepared by mixing raw powders (purity > 99.5 wt.%), ball-milling (stainless steel ball-to-powder ratio 10:1, 150 rpm, 8 h), and sintering via spark plasma sintering (SPS) at 1700 °C under 30 MPa pressure with 10 min holding time and 100 °C/min heating rate in argon atmosphere.
